outline.title: The minor pentatonic scale
outline.summary: The five-note scale behind most rock and blues solos.

lessons.title: Pentatonic box 1
lessons.summary: Play the first box of the A minor pentatonic scale up and down.

lessons.title: Alternate picking
lessons.summary: Pick down and up evenly through the scale.

lessons.title: Pentatonic box 2
lessons.summary: Extend the scale with the second box and connect them.

lessons.title: Your first licks
lessons.summary: Play short, memorable phrases from the scale.

lessons.title: Call and response
lessons.summary: Answer a phrase from the app with a phrase of your own.

outline.title: Expressive techniques
outline.summary: Slides, bends and vibrato: making notes sing.

lessons.title: Slides
lessons.summary: Slide into and between notes along one string.

lessons.title: Half-step bends
lessons.summary: Bend a note up one fret's worth and hear it in tune.

lessons.title: Whole-step bends
lessons.summary: Bend up two frets' worth with support from other fingers.

lessons.title: Vibrato
lessons.summary: Add a steady, controlled wobble to a held note.

lessons.title: Expressive licks
lessons.summary: Combine slides, bends and vibrato in short phrases.

outline.title: The 12-bar blues
outline.summary: The form behind countless songs, and your first solos over it.

lessons.title: The 12-bar form
lessons.summary: Follow the I–IV–V changes of a 12-bar blues in A.

lessons.title: The blues shuffle
lessons.summary: Play the classic shuffle rhythm on the low strings.

lessons.title: Soloing over the changes
lessons.summary: Use pentatonic licks that fit each chord of the blues.

lessons.title: Turnarounds
lessons.summary: End each chorus with a turnaround that leads back to the top.

lessons.title: Stage song: A traditional blues
lessons.summary: Play rhythm and a short solo over a full 12-bar blues.
